Yeah, asha tisa' BEFORE Amal, and Amal herself says at 06:51-06:54 'I just repeated what you said' (they had just agreed at 04:46-05:48 that she would stop echoing his correct lines) - so D11 is dropped. (2) The كهربجي word (09:10-09:42) is ONE didn't-know: Amal volunteered it at 09:10, his 09:30 كرهبجي / 09:39 كراجي are first tries at a word he says is new, her 09:42 is a re-teach - kept once as tier 0 (D2), D12 dropped as the same moment. Plural-shape slips (D4 الأيوم, D8 الفعلات) are filed as grammar A9 to match the agreed A30 كاسته -> كاساته. D7 and D15 are the same انكسر-for-خربان slip (48:41 first, 49:28 a repeat inside the same explanation) - kept once at 48:41.
